Perfect! After Qb3+ Kh8 Qxa2, White has won the rook on a2 (up material by 5 points). Even if Black plays Qxe3+, White remains up a full rook. This is the winning move.

**Best move:** Qb3+

**Main line:** Qb3+ Kh8 Qxa2 (winning the rook) Qxe3 Qxd3 (White up a rook)

**Motif:** fork

**Coaching note:**
When your opponent has loose pieces, look for checks that attack multiple targets. Here, Qb3+ gives check and simultaneously attacks both Black rooks—the one on d4 and the one that just moved to a2. Black's king must move, and then you simply capture one rook. This is a classic royal fork: check the king while attacking undefended pieces.
